Protein–pathway interactions from DEPs of PsA males vs females

Protein–pathway interactions from DEPs of PsA males vs females. Proteins (grey nodes, red highlight for fold-change) connect to pathways (diamond nodes, darker shades for more enriching proteins). Edge colour indicates sex- and disease-specific associations: blue for DEPs in both PsA males vs females and PsA males vs controls (male differential), pink for PsA males vs females and PsA females vs controls (female differential) and orange for PsA males vs females only (sex-differential within PsA). Edge thickness reflects statistical significance, and thicker protein nodes indicate higher fold changes. DEP: differentially expressed protein
